Great backline defense for pushing enemies back. |tooltip-2 = Capable of detecting [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]], [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] and [[flying]] enemies. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A mad explosives expert capable of knocking back and burning enemies.|Inventory Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Hallow Punk''' is an exclusive ground [[Towers|tower]] that deals [[Splash Damage]], which knocks back all enemies hit. It is unlocked by triumphing all the [[Hexscape Event]] nights on the Easy difficulty. Most recently, it was obtainable through a limited-time gamepass for {{Robux|299}}. The '''Hallow Punk''' is an early-game [[Splash Damage]] tower that deals medium damage to enemies within an explosion radius. However, the '''Hallow Punk''' has a slow firerate. All enemies hit by it will be knocked back, with the distance depending on its size, while at Level 2 and above, will have burn applied to them. Additionally, it does not have damage drop off when enemies are away from the center. It does not bypass defense. This tower has lead detection at Level 0+, hidden detection at Level 2+ and flying detection at Level 3, making it effective against all types of enemies. The '''Hallow Punk''' can be effective against low-mid health crowds of enemies, but struggles against high health hordes of enemies. It can however be useful at knocking them back. The '''Hallow Punk''' is considered an early-mid-game tower.
